title: Atlas × Jev Phase-2.2 independent defect review (one reviewer, one batch item)
description: Schema for a SINGLE independent human defect judgment. One file per (batch_id, reviewer_id), stored as phase2.2/reviews/<batch_id>__<reviewer_id>.json. Reviewer-facing batch IDs (P22-XXX) are opaque: the record_id mapping lives ONLY in sealed files that reviewers must not open mid-pass. JEV signals/scores/flags, Phase-2.1 human labels, and threshold results must never appear in this file.

batch_id.description: Opaque batch item ID. Must exist in record_map.sealed.json. Never a raw Atlas record_id.

reviewer_id.description: Stable anonymous reviewer ID. Two DIFFERENT reviewer_ids required per batch item. Must match the __<reviewer_id> filename suffix.

reviewed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this judgment was recorded.

blinded_to_jev.description: Attestation: reviewer completed this item WITHOUT seeing JEV signals/scores/flags or threshold results.

blinded_to_prior_labels.description: Attestation: reviewer completed this item WITHOUT seeing Phase-2.1 (or any prior) human labels for this content.

correctness.description: Is the assistant response substantively correct? Finding direction: 'no'.

problematic.description: 'yes' = unsuitable as training data. Finding direction: 'yes'.

category_correct.description: Content genuinely belongs to its category label per taxonomy_reference_v1. Finding direction: 'no'.

truncation_incomplete.description: 'yes' = response cut off mid-reasoning, missing conclusion/boxed answer, or visibly incomplete. Finding direction: 'yes'.

factual_technical_error.description: 'yes' = concrete wrong fact, wrong derivation step, or code that cannot work as claimed. Finding direction: 'yes'.

instruction_violation.description: 'yes' = response ignores or contradicts the user request (answers a different question, wrong output contract). Finding direction: 'yes'.

malformed_output.description: 'yes' = garbled text, broken encoding, stray pasted fragments, or structure so broken it is unusable. Finding direction: 'yes'.

other_defect.description: 'yes' = concrete defect not covered above (describe in evidence). Finding direction: 'yes'.

evidence.description: Short evidence/reason string per dimension. REQUIRED (min 10 non-space chars) for every finding-direction verdict; must pinpoint the defect (quote or step reference), not a bare restatement of the verdict.

notes.description: Optional free text (never a substitute for labels + evidence).
